board: Waveshare BMM150 3-Axis Magnetometer Sensor (5-pin PH2.0 connector: INT, SCL, SDA, GND, VCC)
reason: Part check PASS on the first run (ESP32 and Pico: spec, wiring, design checks, breadboard, simulator, circuit board, footprint). The sim encodes X/Y as 13-bit and Z as 15-bit two's complement in 0x42-0x47, with RHALL and DRDY in 0x48/0x49 and a fixed set of trim registers. The real driver decodes these with Bosch's trim-based compensation, and forced mode and repetitions follow the datasheet. Address is 0x13 because the board pulls CSB and SDO high.
